config.worktreeExplorer.vscodeCommand.de: Command used to open VS Code from Cursor or another host.
config.worktreeExplorer.defaultBranchPre: Default prefix suggested when creating a new local branch.
config.worktreeExplorer.autoRefresh.desc: When the Worktrees view refreshes automatically.
Refresh only when the Refresh button is pressed.
Refresh when the window gains focus (debounced).
config.worktreeExplorer.refreshIntervalS: Interval in seconds when autoRefresh is set to interval.
config.worktreeExplorer.copyDirs.descrip: Relative settings directories copied from the source worktree into a newly created worktree.
Ask for confirmation before copying settings directories into a new worktree.
config.worktreeExplorer.noteMaxLength.de: Maximum note length shown in the tree item description before truncation.
config.worktreeExplorer.statusCacheSecon: Cache worktree status for this many seconds. 0 disables caching.
config.worktreeExplorer.statusConcurrenc: Maximum number of git status processes started in parallel.
